meaning:
§ Migron = "precipice"
a place near Gibeah north of Michmash

elsewhere.note: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people who were with him were about six hundred men;
He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
